verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents an official pricing calculator where you 'add and configure products to get a cost estimate,' which covers estimating a stack before committing. The free-tier page publishes free usage limits and the $300 credit terms with no charge until a paid account is activated. However, no evidence shows public per-service pricing pages with actual rates. missing for 10: evidence of public per-service pricing pages with published rates, independent or hands-on corroboration that calculator estimates match real bills.

support.subject: As a founder, prices are published — public per-service pricing pages and an official calculator I can estimate a stack with before signing anything

citations.quote: Add and configure products to get a cost estimate to share with your team.
There is no charge to use these products up to their specified free usage limit.
You won't be charged until you activate your full paid account.
